DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, January 18, 2019 Posted by admin on January 18th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +158 points.
Thursday the Dow was up +162.94 (+0.67%) at 24,370.10.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +4.47%.
There were 24 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) +2.96%, Caterpillaar (CAT) +2.19% and Boeing (BA) +2.00%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Home Depot (HD) -1.23%, UnitedHealth (UNH) -0.65% and Verizon (VZ) -0.44%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.242 per gallon.
